question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Many unavoidable situations were avoided only because someone __had our back__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"had our back"** means to support or defend someone. (समर्थन करना या बचाव करना)

 
 
• **Example:** No matter what happens, I know my family will always **have my back.**
 
 
 
• **"Support"** refers to giving assistance, backing, or help to someone. (समर्थन)
 
 
• **Example:** The manager's** support **was crucial in getting the project completed on time.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **To support**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In consultation** (परामर्श में): Seeking advice or information from someone.

 
 
• **Example:** In consultation with the experts, the company decided to change its strategy.
 
 
 
• **Without help** (बिना मदद के): Not receiving assistance from anyone.
 
 
• **Example:** She managed to complete the task without help from her colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Within reach** (पहुंच के भीतर): Something that is easily accessible or attainable.
 
 
• **Example:** The book was within reach on the top shelf.
 
 

 

31:Tbdb,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
